translationRepairs: In the first year of Shengzong Tonghe issued an edict left and right chancellors and associate directors for the three capitals.
In the first year of Shengzong's Tonghe, an edict established left and right chancellors and left and right associate directors for the three capitals.
The revision supplies the missing passive construction and preserves both paired sets of offices in 左右相、左右平章事.
In the first year of Taizong Datong made Zhao Yanshou Zhongjing retention commissioner at Zhenzhou.
In the first year of Taizong's Datong, Zhao Yanshou was made Zhongjing retention commissioner, governing Zhenzhou.
The passive appointment is grammatical, and 治鎮州 means that the office governed from Zhenzhou.
Taizong Tianxian year 3 raised Dongping Commandery to Nanjing at Liaoyang.
In Taizong's Tianxian year 3, Dongping Commandery was raised to Nanjing, governing Liaoyang.
The revision gives the sentence a clear passive verb and correctly renders 治遼陽 as governing from Liaoyang.
